name: ColorManagedViewSettings
description: Color management settings used for displaying images on the display

props.name: Look
props.description: Additional transform applied before view transform for artistic needs

items.name: None
items.description: Do not modify image in an artistic manner

props.name: View
props.description: View used when converting image to a display space

items.name: None
items.description: Do not perform any color transform on display, use old non-color managed technique for display

props.name: Exposure
props.description: Exposure (stops) applied before display transform, multiplying by 2^exposure

props.name: Gamma
props.description: Additional gamma encoding after display transform, for output with custom gamma

props.name: Curve
props.description: Color curve mapping applied before display transform

props.name: Use Curves
props.description: Use RGB curved for pre-display transformation

props.name: Use White Balance
props.description: Perform chromatic adaption from a different white point

props.name: Temperature
props.description: Color temperature of the scene's white point

props.name: Tint
props.description: Color tint of the scene's white point (the default of 10 matches daylight)

props.name: White Point
props.description: The color which gets mapped to white (automatically converted to/from temperature and tint)

props.name: Is HDR
props.description: The display and view transform supports high dynamic range colors

props.name: Support Emulation
props.description: The display and view transform supports automatic emulation for another display device, using the display color spaces mechanism in OpenColorIO v2 configurations
